nodes.question: Which institutions are involved in marine research related to algae and sea cucumbers in Shandong, China?
nodes.answer: The Shandong Technology Innovation Center of Algae and Sea Cucumber and the Provincial Key Laboratory of Marine Seed Industry of Shandong are involved in marine research.
